pairs.line1: I kept the enemy watched today, Sire. I know more than I did.
pairs.line2: Still nothing to fight, Sire. The men are restless, and so am I.

pairs.line1: They beat us off, Sire. I'll be more careful — for now.
pairs.line2: A loss. I'm keeping closer to my lines.
It's done, Sire. Without much loss, I'm glad to say.

pairs.line1: On the road, with my rear well held.

pairs.line2: Understood. I'll not waste a man.
Understood. No need to hurry me.

pairs.line1: A bad day for the cavalry. It makes me think twice.
pairs.line2: A loss. I'm keeping closer to my lines.

pairs.line1: A third night of the same? No — I've found something better to do.
pairs.line2: Even I can't do the same thing three nights, Sire. I've changed it.

pairs.line1: No guns near me yet, Sire.
pairs.line2: I see dust on the roads and none of it worth following.

pairs.line1: You call me back, Sire? I was just getting started.
pairs.line2: I return the task to you, Sire. Gladly.
The task is complete, Sire. The corps is intact.

pairs.line1: Tell me where to ride, Sire.
pairs.line2: Tell me what you want done, Sire.

rows.line: We fought today. The men did all I asked.
It was the right moment, so I took it.
I got there in time. That's what counts.
There was fighting today. I kept the losses low.
They came too close, so I hit them.
The cavalry was in it today.
Marching toward the sound of it, Sire.
On the road, Sire. We'll be up with them soon.
Riding hard, Sire. We gain on them every hour.
A march nearer. I leave nothing loose behind me.
Moving up, a careful march at a time.
Some progress today. More tomorrow, I expect.
Understood. I'll not waste a man.
Done. Where the guns are, I'll be.
At last, Sire! Leave it to me.
A fine task. I'll enjoy this one.
Consider it done, Sire.
Understood. No need to hurry me.
It's done, Sire. Who's next?
Done, Sire. I've lost nothing doing it.
Task done. I'd do it again.
Finished as you asked. I await the next.
It's done, Sire. Without much loss, I'm glad to say.
Finished, Sire. Find me another fight.
I waited for a clearer picture, Sire. One can hardly be blamed.
No assault today. I'll tell you straight when there's one worth making.
I stayed where I was. Tomorrow I fight, Sire.
I kept the horses in. Even I can do that, once.
No move today. Nothing was ready to my standard, Sire.
No move today. Here I know what I have.
